reports.title: Règlement N° 03/21-CEMAC-UEAC-CM-36 portant modalités d'élaboration, de calcul et de publication de l'indice harmonisé des prix à la consommation
reports.publisher: CEMAC (Communauté Économique et Monétaire de l'Afrique Centrale)
reports.region: CEMAC (Cameroon, Central African Republic, Congo, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, Chad)
reports.description: The CEMAC-wide binding regulation establishing the harmonized CPI, dated 27 January 2021. The CEMAC Commission's own 2024 inflation note (page 5) describes it as covering "modalités d'élaboration, de calcul et de publication de l'indice harmonisé des prix à la consommation" [procedures for developing, calculating and publishing the harmonized consumer price index], with "a methodological guide attached to this regulation." This closes three existing _dropped leads sitting unresolved in cm-cpi-social-protection.json, ga-cpi-social-protection.json and td-cpi-social-protection.json, all of which had already identified this exact regulation number by title but not fetched or minted it. A companion instrument, Regulation N°04/21-UEAC-115-CM-36, covers "modalités d'élaboration, de calcul et de diffusion de l'inflation sous-jacente" [underlying/core inflation] — not minted this round, flagged below. AFRISTAT's own CEMAC methodology document (APA04, 'Fondements Méthodologiques de l'Indice Harmonisé des Prix des Etats Membres de la CEMAC') independently confirms the six covered states by name: "Cameroun, Centrafrique, Congo, Gabon; Guinée Equatoriale et Tchad," and identifies itself as published by AFRISTAT, though it does not itself state the regulation number — the regulation number comes from the CEMAC Commission's own note, not the AFRISTAT guide.
reports.cadence_note: One-off foundational instrument (a supranational regulation), the same shape as eu-reg-2016-2304 and eac-hcpi-regulations already in the corpus.

reports.title: Indice Harmonisé des Prix à la Consommation (IHPC)
reports.publisher: Institut Centrafricain des Statistiques et des Etudes Economiques et Sociales (ICASEES)
reports.description: The Central African Republic's monthly CPI, published by ICASEES, described on its own dissemination calendar as an "Indice à 12 fonctions" (COICOP-style 12-division index), with monthly releases typically around the 10th of the following month.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly; ICASEES's own dissemination calendar lists releases through 2025.

reports.title: Indice National Harmonisé des Prix à la Consommation des Ménages (INHPC)
reports.description: Congo's monthly harmonized CPI. The August 2025 bulletin states: "l'Indice national harmonisé des prix à la consommation des ménages (INHPC) s'établit à 117,8 points," reporting 0.1% monthly and 1.7% annual inflation.
reports.cadence_note: Monthly bulletin series ("Bulletin INHPC"), individually numbered by month back to at least January 2022.

reports.title: Anuario Estadístico de Guinea Ecuatorial 2024
reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística de Guinea Ecuatorial (INEGE)
reports.description: UPDATE 2026-08-13 (AF/G.23, AFRISTAT/IFORD contribution table + regional-body glossary confirmation): Sección 13 Finanzas Públicas, Tabla 199 ("Financiación a la Estadística (Millones de F.CFA)") documents a quantified government financial contribution to the regional bodies: "Contribuciones del Gobierno a AFRISTAT ... 380" and "Contribuciones del Gobierno a IFORD ... 82" for 2022 (nil/not-reported in 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2023 — a one-off documented data point, not a recurring line). The yearbook's own Glosario de Siglas separately defines "AFRISTAT Observatorio Económico y Estadístico de África Subsahariana," "CEMAC Comunidad Económica y Monetaria de África Central," "COICOP Clasificación del Consumo Individual según el Propósito" and "OIT Organización Internacional del Trabajo" — correcting the original note below that "No CEMAC or AFRISTAT reference found"; both are in fact named in the document, though only at the acronym-glossary level, not in a standalone methodology statement tying COICOP to the IPC table's construction (see this round's _dropped notes in gq-g23-municipal.json). Independently downloaded and pdftotext-extracted, not AI-summarized. INEGE's statistical yearbook, described in its own text as "la séptima edición del Anuario Estadístico de Guinea Ecuatorial" (the seventh edition), presenting data retrospectively through 2023, including an "Índice de Precios de Consumo (IPC) nacional" table with quarterly data and inflation rates by city. No CEMAC or AFRISTAT reference found in the excerpted content. News coverage (ahoraeg.com, guineaecuatorialpress.com, not independently opened as primary sources this round) references INEGE's own separate monthly IPC releases, suggesting a narrower dedicated CPI bulletin exists beyond this yearbook — not located this round, see deferred note below.

The CEMAC Commission's own 2024 inflation note names the Central African Republic as one of the six member states whose national CPI feeds the union-wide harmonized index under this regulation (Tableau 1, page 5, and country section from page 9). ICASEES's own bulletin content did not itself cite the regulation in the excerpt fetched this round, so this edge rests on the union-side document, the same evidentiary pattern already used for Côte d'Ivoire and Senegal against the WAEMU hub in af-continental-hub.json.
